proposal.expected_benefit: This will ensure that the audit system is properly enforced, even when the audit anchor is failed, thereby preventing bypassing of audit requirements and ensuring compliance with pre-execution requirements.
proposal.problem: The defense assumes that audit-before-execution is sufficient, but the scenario indicates that the audit anchor is failed, which may imply that the audit system is not functioning as intended. The defense should clarify how the audit system will be enforced and ensure that the audit anchor is not bypassed.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a clear and explicit audit enforcement strategy that addresses the failed audit anchor. This includes defining how audit-before-execution will be enforced, ensuring that the audit system is not bypassed, and resolving contradictions between audit status and compliance decisions to ensure robust control implementation.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit Enforcement and Compliance Integration
verification_tests: Verify that the audit system is enforced even when the audit anchor is failed.
Ensure that contradictions between audit status and compliance decisions are resolved.
